name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0: Global Gridded Soil Property Prediction Maps
description: SoilGrids 2.0 is a global collection of digital soil property maps generated at 250-meter spatial resolution by ISRIC - World Soil Information. Using machine learning models trained on approximately 240,000 ground soil profiles and over 400 environmental covariates, SoilGrids 2.0 predicts key physical and chemical soil properties (soil organic carbon, bulk density, pH, cation exchange capacity, total nitrogen, and sand, silt, and clay fractions) across six standardized depth intervals (0-5, 5-15, 15-30, 30-60, 60-100, and 100-200 cm) alongside spatial uncertainty estimates.
